description: The real shipped ovos-core default intent pipeline, reproduced faithfully with the arena's available plugins: Padatious high, Adapt high, m2v (Model2Vec embedding) high, Adapt medium.
notes: SOURCE: the exact shipped order, verbatim, from the installed ovos-config package's default mycroft.conf — /home/miro/.venvs/ovos/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ovos_config/mycroft.conf, 'intents.pipeline' key, lines 218-231 (ovos-config==<installed version>): ["ovos-stop-pipeline-plugin-high", "ovos-converse-pipeline-plugin", "ovos-ocp-pipeline-plugin-high", "ovos-padatious-pipeline-plugin-high", "ovos-adapt-pipeline-plugin-high", "ovos-m2v-pipeline-high", "ovos-ocp-pipeline-plugin-medium", "ovos-fallback-pipeline-plugin-high", "ovos-stop-pipeline-plugin-medium", "ovos-adapt-pipeline-plugin-medium", "ovos-fallback-pipeline-plugin-medium", "ovos-fallback-pipeline-plugin-low"]. SKIPS (arena cannot instantiate these outside a full ovos-core session — no skill-service converse loop, no OCP media-skill roster, no fallback-skill registry): ovos-stop-pipeline-plugin-{high,medium} (requires a running skill with stop handlers), ovos-converse-pipeline-plugin (requires active-skill session state), ovos-ocp-pipeline-plugin-{high,medium} (requires OCP media skills registered), ovos-fallback-pipeline-plugin-{high,medium,low} (requires fallback-skill registrations; nothing left to fall back to in the intent-only benchmark). What remains — padatious-high, adapt-high, m2v-high, adapt-medium — is exactly the intent-classifier subset of the stock order, in stock order, so this fighter is the arena's best-effort faithful reproduction of 'what ovos-core actually ships', not a curated fusion hypothesis. m2v-pipeline config keys verified in ovos_m2v_pipeline/__init__.py: conf_high (default 0.7), conf_medium (default 0.5, note the plugin uses 'conf_medium' not 'conf_med'), conf_low (default 0.15).
